paragraphs: Abba, father of Rabbi Yirmeyah. In chapter Hattekhelet (47a): the father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba recited a teaching. At the end of chapter Bameh Behemah, Rav said: “Among penitents you have none greater than Josiah in his generation, and another in our generation. Who is it? Abba, father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba.” Some say: Acha, brother of Abba, father of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba; for the master said that Rabbi Abba and Acha were brothers. Rav Yosef said: “And another in our generation. Who is it? Ukban bar Nechemyah, the exilarch”—that is Natan of Tzutzita (see there). Ze'ira spoke in his name; Rava spoke in his name.
